name: Orendil Broadleaf
summary: At Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale, night elf Orendil Broadleaf tends to the sick. His knowledge of forest plants helps him make remedies for young lives in the troubled woodlands.

sections.title: Healer of the Forest Border
sections.body: At Maestra's Post on Ashenvale's western border, Orendil Broadleaf cares for the sick. The skilled healer knows the local herbs and how to use them in restorative remedies. He depends on travelers passing through to gather rare plants and other natural ingredients. Tension and conflict press closer to the forest, but Orendil remains focused on protecting his kin and easing their ailments.

sections.title: A Race Against Sickness
sections.body: Orendil Broadleaf plays a central part in the effort to cure Relara Whitemoon, an afflicted child in Astranaar. He studies Ashenvale's plants, including Bathran's hair, and devises potent elixirs to hold back the deadly sickness. Relara's illness remains a danger, and Orendil's remedies are meant to keep it at bay.

faq.answer: Orendil Broadleaf is a night elf herbalist and healer at Maestra's Post in western Ashenvale. He is known for his skill with herbs and healing.

faq.q: Where can Orendil Broadleaf be found?
faq.answer: Orendil Broadleaf can be found at Maestra's Post, a night elf outpost along the main path in western Ashenvale, near the border with Darkshore.

faq.q: What is Orendil trying to cure?
faq.answer: Orendil formulates a curative draught to save Relara Whitemoon, an ailing night elf child in Astranaar. He uses rare herbs gathered from Ashenvale's wild reaches.

angles.text: Orendil shows how regional plants can save lives, relying on rare botanicals such as Bathran's hair to brew potent antidotes in the field.
As a night elf defending Ashenvale, you can look to Orendil for remedies that may save even a deathly ill child.
